title: Refusal suppression
summary: Extracts the direction that separates prompts which tend to draw a refusal from ordinary helpful requests. Ablating that direction reduces refusal behavior on the model it was extracted from.

advice: Start at 0.3 over the full band. If the trait persists, raise toward 0.5 and re-run the check. Past 0.6 an ablation can collapse generation entirely; see docs/OBLITERATION.md. Refusal behavior varies by checkpoint, so judge the result by the check output and your own prompts, not by the file name.
